summary: iQIYI (Nasdaq: IQ) filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Ying Tian as CFO, effective July 2, 2026, replacing interim CFO Ying Zeng who reverted to SVP of Finance. The change is not forced or abrupt; it is a planned leadership succession. No deal terms, premium, or shareholder vote are involved. The filing is a routine executive change under a foreign private issuer report. Watch for any future strategic shifts under the new CFO.
